description: Draws the open CIVIL NX model as DXF with the Model to IFC plugin's drawing engine: a 2D drawing file (DXF 2000: plan, elevation developed along the deck, hidden-line isometric, section cuts with hatched faces and tendon ducts, and every section in use dimensioned) and a 3D DXF (one polyface mesh per element, layered by role, DXF 2000 or R12). Cuts are given in metres: {kind:'cross', at: chainage} across the deck, {kind:'long', at: offset left of the centreline}, {kind:'level', at: height}, with depth = how far beyond the cut to draw; none given = one across mid-span, cutsAtSupports adds one at each pier and abutment. Only reads the model; returns download links.

format3d.description: R12 is about half the size (Autodesk Viewer may show it empty).

hidden.description: Hidden lines dashed in plan and elevation.

joinDeck.description: Join side-by-side girders' slab strips into one continuous deck.

max3dMegabytes.description: Skip the 3D file (and say so) if it would be larger than this.

name.description: File / model name (default: the model's project name).

separateSlabs.description: A composite section's deck slab as its own slab.

skipWeightless.description: Leave out weightless (dummy) members; cables, piles and members named NoSW are kept.

startStation.description: Chainage at the start of the deck, m.

tendons.description: Tendons drawn at their duct diameter.

units.description: Drawing unit (dimensions); levels and chainages are labelled in m (ft for imperial).

views.description: Which 2D views (default all: plan, elevation, iso, cuts, sections).

wireframe.description: 3D: element centrelines and plate outlines on a non-plotting layer.

name: model_to_dxf
title: Model to IFC — DXF drawings and 3D DXF
